# viettelcloud_project_custom_role (Data Source)

Get a custom role of the configured Viettel Cloud project by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a custom role by ID.
data "viettelcloud_project_custom_role" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Look up a custom role by its exact name.
data "viettelcloud_project_custom_role" "by_name" {
  name = "doi-van-hanh"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Custom Role ID (UUID) to look up.
- `name` (String) Custom Role name to look up. It must match exactly; `ops` does not match `ops-admin`.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (Attributes Set) IAM actions that the Custom Role grants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Custom Role was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the Custom Role.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the Custom Role.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Custom Role grants its actions.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Custom Role was last updated (RFC3339).
- `urn` (String) Custom Role URN.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Read-Only:

- `urn` (String) URN of the IAM action.
